label: class_g_01_home_01
text: I see we have some energetic young ones in our\nclass this time around.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: class_g_01_home_02
text: You may call me Mr. Saguaro.\c\nYour time here with me will be spent obtaining\nknowledge and skills indispensable for daily life.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_03
text: Many of you have left the care of your parents to\nlive here on your own in the academy dormitory.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_04
text: I pray that the knowledge I impart to you will\nimprove the quality of your lives and the\r\nnecessities thereof—food, clothing, and shelter.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_05
text: Of those three categories, I assume the most\npressing and interesting for you all is food.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_06
text:
When you eat sandwiches on your picnics, the HP
of your party Pokémon will be restored.\c
You will also gain something called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Meal Powers[VAR 0xFF00(0000)],
which can provide all manner of benefits.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_07
text: For example, these powers can make Pokémon\neasier to catch or increase the Exp. Points that\r\nyour Pokémon receive.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_08
text: I think you will also find that the breadth of these\neffects can be expanded by crafting sandwiches\r\nof superb flavor.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_09
text: What’s more, there is a certain something that is\nparticularly important if we wish to receive Meal\r\nPowers with even more helpful effects.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_10
text: Let me see... M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nTell me—what must you keep in mind to receive\neven more helpful Meal Powers?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_select_01
text: My choice of fillings and condiments

label: class_g_01_select_02
text: How fast I can prepare the food

label: class_g_01_select_03
text: I have to remember to put my heart into it!

label: class_g_01_home_answer_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Perfectly correct, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
Perhaps you were already aware of this fact from
having helped your family with cooking at home?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_answer_02
text: That is...incorrect. I pray that you all put more\nemphasis on doing things well when cooking\r\nrather than simply rushing to finish quickly.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_answer_03
text: Ha! That is an interesting take. Though not\nexactly what I was looking for, I suppose you are\r\ncorrect, in a sense.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_11
text: Your choice of ingredients—including both fillings\nand condiments—is an important factor in gaining\r\neven more helpful Meal Powers.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_12
text: For example, using sweet ingredients in your\nsandwiches may help you gain Egg Power.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_13
text: Including numerous bitter ingredients, on the\nother hand, can gain you Item Drop Power.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_14
text:
Learning to aim for specific effects when crafting
sandwiches will almost certainly make your
culinary endeavors more enjoyable.\c
Please be aware, however, that you can also
receive Meal Powers by eating at restaurants.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_15
text: I must say that I would feel the utmost joy if you\nall learned much here in my class and came to\r\nbetter understand home economics.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_01_home_16
text: Our time together has come to an end for today.\nI bid you all farewell.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
